2.88.57
Chart.Visibility
The Chart.Visibility element specifies the visibility of a Chart. The Chart.Visibility element is
optional. This element is of type Visibility.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.Visibility element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0" />
